What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of a right-opening parabola is the left-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14003808/assets/7032a13b6672d8bf66ead31a54577d25bbd47640d8c3cffeedd069d57eec9338.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(3,0).$
